subject.title: Oceanside Unified School District Board, Trustee Area 3

text: I am Dr. Joey Pearson, and Oceanside is my home and the community I am proud to serve. I believe every student deserves the opportunity to learn, belong, and thrive. That is why I am running for Oceanside Unified School District Board of Education: Strong public schools are the heart of our community and the foundation of our democracy.

I began my career as a public-school teacher, serving students and families in North County. Since then, I have designed curriculum, coached teachers, and led programs preparing thousands of teachers for the classroom. Today I lead teams creating programs that prepare professionals to use new technology responsibly. I earned a doctorate in education from UCLA and serve on education boards and accreditation teams.

Lasting progress begins by listening and turning what we hear into responsible action. As Area 3 trustee, I will champion safe, welcoming schools; bilingual and special education; support for student well-being; excellent college and career pathways; and practical preparation for emerging technology. I will protect taxpayer dollars through transparent, fiscally responsible decisions that put students and teachers first.
I am honored to be endorsed by the Oceanside Teachers Association, and I respectfully ask for your vote. www.PearsonForOUSD.com

text: As a proud Oceanside Unified alumna, mother, educator, and business owner, I am honored to seek your vote for Oceanside Unified School District Trustee, Area 3. I attended Oceanside Unified schools from kindergarten through graduation, and the experiences I had as a student continue to shape my commitment to our community today.

As the owner of an educational services business, I have dedicated my career to helping students succeed and supporting families through education. My experiences as a former student, educator, and parent have given me a unique understanding of the opportunities and challenges facing our schools.

I am committed to academic excellence, transparency, and accountability while fostering strong partnerships between students, families, educators, and the community. I believe every child deserves the opportunity to receive a quality education in a safe and supportive learning environment.
It would be an honor to serve the community that invested in me and work together to help ensure every Oceanside Unified student has the opportunity to succeed.
